name: REDCap MCP Gateway
description: Provides narrowly scoped, token-authenticated REDCap API actions for an MCP transport server.

project-settings.name: Allow REDCap Identifier fields to be exported through MCP
Minimum cell size for MCP identifier aggregates

project-overview.description: Returns read-only project context for reporting.

project-schema.description: Returns the data dictionary for the API token's project. The token owner must have Project Design/Setup rights. Optional fields[] and forms[] parameters limit the result.

project-structure.description: Returns read-only reporting context: arms, events, form/event mapping, repeating configuration, and data access groups.

list-reports.description: Lists saved reports in the API token's project.

get-report.description: Exports a bounded page of a saved report's data as JSON. Specify report-id; optional limit (maximum 1000) and offset.

export-records.description: Exports a bounded, read-only page of selected fields or forms. Requires fields[] or forms[]; supports records[], events[], groups[], filter_logic, raw_or_label, and limit (maximum 1000).

summarize-fields.description: Returns missingness and frequency summaries for selected fields, with optional record/event/DAG/filter scoping. Maximum 5000 rows analyzed.

summarize-report.description: Returns missingness and frequency summaries for fields in a saved report. Specify report-id; maximum 5000 rows analyzed.

aggregate-identifier-fields.description: Returns privacy-protected aggregates for Identifier fields without returning any record-level values. Supports numeric means, date-of-birth to age, and cell-size-suppressed categorical counts.

aggregate-categorical-counts.description: Returns a privacy-protected, full-project breakdown for one coded categorical field. Categories below the effective minimum cell size are individually suppressed; caller-defined cohorts and pagination are not permitted.

aggregate-checkbox-counts.description: Returns a privacy-protected, full-project count for each option of one checkbox field with per-option small-cell suppression.

aggregate-numeric-distribution.description: Returns a privacy-protected, full-project five-bin distribution for one validated numeric field with per-bin small-cell suppression.

aggregate-age-distribution.description: Returns a privacy-protected, full-project age-band distribution derived from one date field with per-band small-cell suppression.

aggregate-date-distribution.description: Returns a privacy-protected, full-project year distribution for one date field with per-year small-cell suppression.

aggregate-completion-counts.description: Returns privacy-protected, full-project form completion-status counts with per-status small-cell suppression.

aggregate-missingness.description: Returns privacy-protected, full-project missing/nonmissing counts for selected fields with per-cell small-cell suppression.
